svg.title: 08 · Published scenarios and execution
svg.desc: Published scenarios and execution. Run pins a published Scenario version and exact admission inputs; provider effects remain separate entities

g.text: Run pins a published Scenario version and exact admission inputs; provider effects remain separate entities
version · createdAt · updatedAt | Retained versions never change; a write appends the next version.
EntityRef = {kind, id, version}. A dashed class is the same entity shown on another sheet.
All non-Workspace entities carry workspaceId. Cardinalities describe logical associations; fields shown are selected attributes.

g.title: One versioned scenario entity. Draft editing, publication and archival append versions with the same scenarioId. A Run pins an exact PUBLISHED version; current ARCHIVED head blocks new admissions.
Versioned admitted workflow execution pinning one exact published Scenario and input Snapshot. Phase, outcome, verdict and finalization remain independent; every state change appends Run.version.
Run-owned step lifecycle. Selection of an attempt is explicit; retry history is retained.
Immutable settled execution facts; late reconciliation adds observations without editing a sealed attempt.
Native AWS FIS experiment, possibly linked to a workflow attempt but independently observable. Actions are provider-owned named values.

A deliberate retained capture with a closed set of exact entity references and captured contents. Snapshot is a business capture, not a substitute for ordinary entity versioning. A corrected capture appends a Snapshot version; older captures stay unchanged.
Native service-scoped assessment execution; execution success, posture and runtime health remain independent.
Scenario 1 → Run 0..*: published version used by

g.text: An edit appends a new DRAFT version.
Publication does not create another entity.
Execution outcome, acceptance verdict and effect cleanup are independent state dimensions.
